name: livebench-score-matrix-snapshot
description: A 49 x 7 score matrix transcribed verbatim from Table 3 of White et al. (LiveBench: A Challenging, Contamination-Free LLM Benchmark, ICLR 2025 Spotlight, arXiv:2406.19314). Columns: model identifier, Coding, Data Analysis, Instruction Following, Language, Math, Reasoning. Original 0-100 scores rescaled to [0,1] for consistency with the companion HF snapshot. Used as a contamination-controlled replication of the redundancy analysis in the accompanying paper.
citeAs: Anonymous Authors. Minimal Sufficient Benchmarks: Score Imputation for Cost-Efficient LLM Leaderboards. NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track (under review). Source data: White, C. et al., LiveBench, ICLR 2025, arXiv:2406.19314.
rai:dataCollection: Manually transcribed from Table 3 of White et al. (arXiv:2406.19314, ICLR 2025 Spotlight). Transcription chosen over scraping the live leaderboard to make the replication exactly reproducible from a single citation. The 0-100 scores in the source are rescaled to [0,1].
rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Sole preprocessing is the rescale from [0,100] to [0,1] (divide by 100). No models excluded; the 49-model snapshot is taken in full from the published table.
rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: No human annotation. Scores are deterministic outputs of running LiveBench's contamination-controlled benchmarks against models, as published by the LiveBench maintainers in their ICLR 2025 paper.
rai:dataUseCases: Cross-leaderboard replication of redundancy analyses; contamination-controlled comparison to open-leaderboard data; meta-evaluation research on whether redundancy structure depends on contamination control.
rai:dataLimitation: (1) Small sample (n=49) leads to wide bootstrap CIs on individual subset orderings. The global pattern (instruction-following-inclusive subsets dominate) is robust across resamples; specific subset orderings between adjacent ranks are not. (2) The 49 models are a snapshot; the live LiveBench leaderboard updates continuously. (3) Six-category scope shared with the HF snapshot, so cross-leaderboard generalization beyond d=6 is unaddressed.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: The transcription is anchored to the published ICLR 2025 Table 3 and is not auto-refreshed; future work would re-transcribe from a newer LiveBench publication or partner directly with LiveBench maintainers for a live API integration.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Enables cross-leaderboard replication of redundancy claims, strengthening the evidence base for compute-efficient evaluation. The contamination-controlled framing addresses a common skepticism about redundancy findings on open leaderboards.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: None. The dataset contains no personal or sensitive information.
